method.tool: Vercel MCP deploy_to_vercel (target=production, name=proklinator-static, teamId omitted)
method.description: build.mjs fetches the 73 site files (2802284 B) from raw.githubusercontent.com (fallback: cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh, 3 attempts per source on network errors, 8 in flight, 30 s timeout per request; a hash or length mismatch is never retried on the same source) at the pinned commit 5771dca and aborts with exit 1 unless each file's byte length and SHA-256 match the values in `files` above, then writes them to ./public and re-checks that the output tree holds exactly the manifest (nothing missing, nothing extra, sizes exact). The deployment therefore contains exactly the repo bytes of the pinned commit; this is the same pattern as the v20, v20.1, v20.2, v20.3 and v20.4 deploys. The manifest was generated from the pinned commit's git blobs (HEAD == origin/main == 5771dca after a fresh fetch, clean tree, blobs cross-checked against the working tree, 0 mismatches) and the script was dry-run locally before deploying with Node 22.14 (73/73 files fetched from raw.githubusercontent.com in 1.2 s and byte-identical to the checkout, output tree == manifest), together with a negative test (one tampered hash for assets/fx/ember-01.png -> both sources rejected, the build aborts with exit 1 after 72/73) and a fallback test (raw host replaced by an unreachable name -> all 73 files come from cdn.jsdelivr.net in 23.4 s, still byte-identical). The Vercel build finished in under three minutes; the raw deployment URL served the verified v20.5 index at the first poll (11:56:38Z) and the public alias followed at 11:56:47Z.

notes: The repository is public (gh: visibility PUBLIC), which is what makes the pinned-commit fetch possible; the ~2.8 MB site tree (73 files, 2802284 B) was therefore not inlined into the MCP request.

The local checkout booted at e827d71 (v20.3); origin/main was fetched first and fast-forwarded to 5771dca (merge of PR #14) before the manifest was generated, so the pinned SHA is the one named in the task.
Git-linked auto-deploy was not used, for the same reasons as before: create_git_project requires teamId (the 403 trigger) and cannot re-link the existing unlinked project proklinator-static.

teamId was omitted from deploy_to_vercel, as in the prior successful deploys; no 403 occurred. Team-scoped read endpoints (get_project / list_projects / get_deployment with the known team id or slug return 404 'Not Found' / 'Deployment not found' / an empty list for this token) were not usable, so the build was followed and verified over HTTP against the raw deployment URL and the public alias.
The existing project proklinator-static was reused (protection already off); no new project was created and no auth/SSO/protection settings were touched. Registration and payments were not opened.

README.md, DEPLOY_RESULT.json, docs/, .gitignore and tools/build_assets.py stay out of the deployment; ATTRIBUTIONS.md (updated) and assets/fx/LICENSE-kenney.txt (new) stay in so the CC0 / ISC / OFL attributions travel with the served files.
